A booking whose event type and organizer have no destinationCalendar (handleNewBooking.ts in this diff explicitly sets destinationCalendar: null in that case) with a Google Meet location crashes EventManager.create with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading integration)', failing the whole booking with a 500 instead of falling back to Cal Video as the previous null-safe `evt.destinationCalendar?.integration` check did.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, the diff changes the Google Meet fallback check to destructure `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? [];` and then read `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` without optional chaining. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, `undefined`, or an empty array, `mainHostDestinationCalendar` is `undefined` and `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` will throw a TypeError. This is reachable because `handleNewBooking.ts` in the diff explicitly sets `destinationCalendar: ... : null` when neither eventType nor organizer has a destination calendar, so a Meet location booking would crash instead of falling back.
